description: This file defines the FileSystem class in Drupal, providing helper methods for file operations such as move, copy, delete, directory management, and stream wrapper handling.

classes.name: FileSystem
classes.description: Provides helper methods for file operations and stream wrapper management within Drupal.

methods.name: moveUploadedFile
methods.description: Moves an uploaded file to a specified URI, retrying with realpath if initial move fails.

methods.name: chmod
methods.description: Sets permissions on a file or directory, using default settings if mode is not specified.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes a file or symbolic link, adjusting permissions on Windows if necessary.

methods.name: realpath
methods.description: Returns the real path of a URI, delegating to stream wrapper if applicable.

methods.name: dirname
methods.description: Returns the directory part of a URI, using stream wrapper if applicable.

methods.name: basename
methods.description: Deprecated method to get filename from URI; suggests using PHP's native basename().

methods.name: mkdir
methods.description: Creates a directory, optionally recursively, handling stream schemes appropriately.

methods.name: rmdir
methods.description: Removes a directory, adjusting permissions on Windows if necessary.

methods.name: tempnam
methods.description: Creates a temporary file in a specified directory, supporting stream schemes.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies a file from source to destination, handling realpath fallback and permissions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a file or symbolic link, throws exception if directory or unrecognized type.

methods.name: deleteRecursive
methods.description: Recursively deletes files and directories, with optional callback.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves or renames a file, with fallback to copy and unlink if rename fails.

methods.name: prepareDestination
methods.description: Prepares source and destination for copy/move, checking existence and permissions.

methods.name: saveData
methods.description: Saves data to a file, writing to a temp file then moving it to final destination.

methods.name: prepareDirectory
methods.description: Ensures a directory exists and is writable, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getDestinationFilename
methods.description: Determines the final filename, handling conflicts based on settings.

methods.name: createFilename
methods.description: Generates a safe filename, appending counters if file exists.

methods.name: getTempDirectory
methods.description: Returns the system or configured temporary directory.

methods.name: scanDirectory
methods.description: Scans a directory for files matching a pattern, with options for recursion and filtering.

methods.name: doScanDirectory
methods.description: Internal method to handle recursive directory scanning.
